title: "as.integer() truncates instead of rounding"
ref: NUM-08
categories: [Numbers]

extrait: 'as.integer(0.29 * 100)'
reponse: '28'

::: {.piege}
```{r}
as.integer(2.9999)
as.integer(-2.9)
as.integer(0.29 * 100)
```
:::

## Why

`as.integer()` drops the decimal part, towards zero: 2.9999 becomes 2 and -2.9 becomes -2. That is not rounding.

Combined with binary representation, the result becomes plainly wrong. `0.29 * 100` prints as `29`, but is actually 28.999999999999996: truncation gives 28. A percentage converted to an integer thus loses one unit without a word.

## The remedy

Round first, convert second.

::: {.piege}
```{r}
as.integer(round(0.29 * 100))
```
:::
